author: agent
log: Mesh 1 has 5595 UV islands (5240 of them 20 triangles or fewer) and the evidence has no colour at all (every island says 'no texture'); only size and at are available, in the mesh frame, and which axis is up is not stated. I therefore could not name any anatomy.
The material name 'Dragon with Attenuation' is the only semantic hint. I used it only as a group/part prefix; I did not infer limbs, head, wings or tail from the islands.

Strategy: the 17 islands with >=1100 triangles each became their own part, named by longest bounding-box axis (LongX/Y/Z) plus a low/mid/high cell on at for each axis (the cell edges 0.34/0.67 are my own choice, not evidence). The other 5578 small islands were merged into 24 position-cell fragment parts (named only by at cell and 'Small_Fragments'); the merge is a shortfall of evidence, not a claim that they are one thing.
Several large islands share the same cell and long axis; I disambiguated them with ordinal suffixes (_Second, _Third), which is a placeholder-like device forced by the unique-name rule.

Mesh 0 (Cloth Backdrop) is one island of 43779 triangles, 6.3 x 3.6 x 6.6, two grey colours 50/50; I made it a single whole part named from the material name and its size/colour; no further separation is supported.

The plan syntax needs every island id listed explicitly (no range or 'rest' form), so the plan file for 5595 islands is large and was typed by hand into the file; that cost a lot and risks transcription slips, which check should catch.
Mesh 1 has no 'components' in the evidence, only islands, so the scene/anchor grain was not available.
